acceptance: The stable package exports explicit v1 contracts and deterministic create/validate/parse/serialize/query primitives without framework, model-provider, or database coupling.
Canonical serialization and revision identity are stable across node/edge insertion order and JSON object key order, while JSON array order remains semantic.
Invalid schema version, blank graph/node/edge identity, blank kind/endpoint, duplicate identity, dangling edge endpoint, non-finite JSON number, and revision tampering are deterministically rejected.
pnpm install --frozen-lockfile recognizes packages/product-graph through an explicit lockfile importer and does not mutate the lockfile.
The canonical structured revision document is the sole authoritative representation exposed by this Grain; relational/index/cache state remains derived and out of scope.
No P02-S02 domain semantic is introduced, and the prototype lab is not imported by the stable package.
Focused Product Graph v1 tests plus full repository format, lint, typecheck, and test suites pass on exact candidate; Ubuntu and Windows CI both pass.
Diffcipline R1 exact-candidate proof, Alibaba OCR deterministic accounting/rule resolution, independent semantic review, and exact-head repository CI are recorded before guarded merge.

required: Stable @ineractive/product-graph v1 contracts and deterministic focused tests.
Frozen-lockfile installation proving the new workspace importer is canonical.
Exact-candidate Diffcipline R1 proof plus Alibaba OCR deterministic accounting/rule resolution and independent semantic review.
Exact-head Ubuntu/Windows repository CI and post-merge fresh-main qualification.

minimality.rationale: Create one small dependency-free stable package plus only the lockfile importer required by the workspace, rather than promoting prototype code or adding persistence/domain layers prematurely.

requirements: Preserve exactly one authoritative structured Product Graph revision representation; derived projections may not become a second source of truth.
Keep domain-specific semantics and validators out of T02B so P02-S02 remains independently reviewable.
Reject malformed or tampered graph documents deterministically before they can be treated as canonical state.

outcome: A stable storage-neutral Product Graph v1 package defines typed node, edge, and immutable revision-document contracts with deterministic canonicalization, validation, serialization, revision identity, and a frozen-installable workspace manifest.
rationale: SG-000018 selected one structured canonical persisted semantic authority; the first SG-000019 candidate exposed a missing lockfile change-surface declaration and was closed as negative evidence, so this fresh Grain authorizes the required workspace lockfile importer explicitly.

risk.recovery: Revert SG-000019 stable package, lockfile importer, evidence, and current-frontier updates; ADR-0003 plus SG-000015 through SG-000018 evidence remain intact and no production data is mutated.

scope_in: Add a stable @ineractive/product-graph package with storage-neutral Product Graph v1 node, edge, structured revision-document, slice, and JSON-value contracts.
Implement deterministic canonicalization and SHA-256 semantic revision identity for the canonical structured document selected by ADR-0003.

Implement validation and parse/serialize helpers that reject invalid schema versions, empty identities/kinds/endpoints, duplicate node or edge identities, dangling edge endpoints, non-finite JSON numbers, and revision tampering.
Add deterministic tests proving round-trip behavior, object-key and insertion-order stability, referential-integrity enforcement, and tamper rejection.
Update pnpm-lock.yaml only as required to register the new dependency-free workspace importer and preserve frozen-lockfile installation.
Advance specs/CURRENT.md so SG-000018 is recorded DONE through PR #32 and SG-000019 is the active T02B implementation Grain.
scope_out: No P02-S02 domain-specific node-kind enumerations, permissions, data-governance semantics, locale semantics, external-effect semantics, or domain validators.
No Change Intent, Question Gate, Assumption Ledger, graph-view UI, compiler, database, Supabase migration, graph database, remote side effect, or derived relational projection implementation.
Do not make stable production contracts depend on packages/product-graph-lab; the prototype lab remains evidence only.
